volatile.pattern: ^user [0-9.]+ s, getrusage user \[[0-9.]+, [0-9.]+\], within 0\.02 s: 1; user > 0: 1$
volatile.reason: process CPU time, 0.060000 s at capture and 0.070000 s on rerun. The two verdicts the line carries, "within 0.02 s: 1" and "user > 0: 1", are part of the pattern, so a run where OCCT and getrusage stop agreeing is still a difference.
